text: Completed 28-row assurance ledger. Re-ran 46 focused adversarial/law cases on JVM and the same 46 on Scala.js: leakage/own-target attacks, keyed reorder, pair reversal, direct-vs-form closure, measurement composition, dense/operator parity, reindex multiplicity, hostile capabilities, design forgery, precision admission, signed nulls, and affine distance metamorphism all passed. Strict run-axis rejection remains a documented product defect, not a weakened guard.
